```{r setup}
#| include: false
source("../R/portal_config.R")
cfg <- portal_cfg
rel <- portal_release
v2_current <- rel$is_current(cfg)
```

This page says what OPDI delivers today, what is planned next, and which
releases of the data have been published. For the changes between the two
latest releases in detail, see [Releases](data/releases.qmd).

## Release v2.0.0

```{r status}
#| results: asis
#| echo: false
if (v2_current) {
  cat("Release ", cfg$release, " is the current release. It covers the days ",
      rel$coverage_text(cfg), ".\n", sep = "")
} else {
  cat("Release ", cfg$release, " is the upcoming release. Its files are being produced, ",
      "starting with the days from ", rel$day_text(cfg$release_coverage$start),
      " onwards. Until they are available, release ", cfg$current_release,
      " is the one to use.\n", sep = "")
}
```

Release v2.0.0 delivers:

- **Daily files**: one flight list and one file of flight events per day. Each
  event row carries its measurements and the columns of its flight.
- **Worldwide coverage**: every flight received by the OpenSky Network, not
  only those in a box around Europe.
- **New events**: runway milestones (line-up, take-off roll, threshold,
  touchdown, runway vacated, runway crossings, go-arounds), block times,
  distance rings, level-offs, holding patterns, point merge legs and FIR
  crossings.
- **A richer flight list**, with take-off, landing and block times, runways,
  stands and the times of crossing distance rings.
- **One flight across a reception gap**, where the data on both sides fit one
  continuous flight.
- **Documented methods**: a page per method with its validation and its
  limits, in [Methods](methods/index.qmd).
- **Access through Trino**, on the OpenSky Network's Trino instance, besides
  the files (see [Access](data/access.qmd)).
- **Daily production**: each new day is processed automatically once the day
  after it is complete.

## Next

These improvements are planned after release v2.0.0. They will be published
as new versions of the methods concerned, so that data already published stay
reproducible.

- **FIR crossings checked against Network Manager records.** The crossings
  are so far compared only with the exact boundaries of the regions (see
  [FIR crossings](methods/fir-crossings.qmd#limitations)).
- **Newer airspace boundaries.** The FIR boundaries are those of one AIRAC
  cycle (524) for every day. Newer cycles, matched to the date of each
  flight, would follow changes of the boundaries.
- **More merge points.** Point merge legs are found only at the airports in
  OPDI's table of merge points (see [Point merge](methods/point-merge.qmd#limitations)).
- **Earlier years.** The daily files are produced from 2025 onwards first.
  The same processing can then be run back to 2019.
- **Validation of the items not yet validated.** The
  [Validation summary](methods/validation-summary.qmd) marks them "Not
  validated".

## Past Releases

| Release | Published | Period covered | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| OPDI v0.0.1 | 2023-12-01 | 2 months | First release: flight list, flight events and measurements. |
| OPDI v0.0.2 (release 1) | 2024-03-01 | 1.5 years | Second version of the flight list, flight event and measurement methods. |
| OPDI v0.0.2 (release 2) | 2024-08-01 | 2.5 years | Same methods, more months. |
| OPDI v0.0.2 (release 3) | 2024-12-01 | 3 years | Same methods, more months. |
| OPDI v0.0.2 (refreshes) | January 2026 to `r cfg$refresh_label` | January 2022 to `r format(cfg$coverage$end, "%B %Y")` | New months added to the same release, at regular refreshes. |
| OPDI `r cfg$release` | `r rel$value_or_tba(cfg$release_date)` | `r if (v2_current) sub("^from ", "", rel$coverage_text(cfg)) else paste("from", rel$day_text(cfg$release_coverage$start), "(planned)")` | Daily files, worldwide; see [Releases](data/releases.qmd). |

The files of release v0.0.2 are on [Previous release v0.0.2](data/v0.0.2.qmd).
